snippet.title: A Lighthouse Tale | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
A Lighthouse Tale is a first-person narrative adventure focused on atmosphere, exploration, and emotional storytelling. Explore a quiet island suspended in time, uncover traces of the past, and piece together a story about family, loss, and healing.

🎮 Wishlist "A Lighthouse Tale" now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3782900/A_Lighthouse_Tale/

🤝Let’s connect on other socials: https://linktr.ee/2020LabStudio
☕Support the game on Ko-fi: https://ko-fi.com/2020labstudio
